sources.name: array
sources.doc: A Polars nested `List` or fixed-size `Array` column.

fields.name: dtype
fields.doc: Element dtype; inferred from the column when absent.

fields.name: require_contiguous
fields.doc: Require rectangular data (zero-copy); jagged rows are then an error.

fields.name: on_error
fields.doc: "raise" (default) or "null": what a row that cannot be decoded does.

sources.name: auto
sources.doc:
Infer the decode path from the column's Polars dtype: String → file_path,
List/Array → list/array, Binary → blob if VIEW-tagged else image_bytes.

fields.name: dtype
fields.doc: Asserted element dtype (a decoded image is cast to it).

fields.name: require_contiguous
fields.doc: Require rectangular data when the column is a List/Array.

fields.name: cloud_options
fields.doc: Cloud-storage credentials when the column is a path.

fields.name: allowed_roots
fields.doc: Locations a path column may read from (unrestricted when absent).

fields.name: decode_max_size
fields.doc: Decode only enough pixels for this long side (JPEG IDCT scaling).

fields.name: on_error
fields.doc: "raise" (default) or "null": what a row that cannot be decoded does.

fields.name: dtype
fields.doc: Asserted element dtype, for the planner: a blob carries its own.

fields.name: on_error
fields.doc: "raise" (default) or "null": what a row that cannot be decoded does.

sources.name: contour
sources.doc:
Contour geometry, rasterized to an `[H, W, 1]` u8 mask — the same contract
the `rasterize` op publishes.

fields.name: size
fields.doc:
``[height, width]`` of the mask (each may be a Polars expression), or
the node whose buffer's height and width the mask takes.

fields.name: fill_value
fields.doc: Inside value. Accepts a Polars expression for per-row values.

fields.name: background
fields.doc: Outside value. Accepts a Polars expression for per-row values.

fields.name: on_error
fields.doc: "raise" (default) or "null": what a row that cannot be decoded does.

sources.name: file_path
sources.doc:
A path (local, s3://, gs://, az://, http://) whose contents decode like
image bytes.

fields.name: dtype
fields.doc: Asserted element dtype: a decoded image with another dtype is cast.

fields.name: cloud_options
fields.doc: Cloud-storage credentials (see `cloud::CloudOptions::from_map`).

fields.name: allowed_roots
fields.doc: Locations the path column may read from (unrestricted when absent).

fields.name: decode_max_size
fields.doc: Decode only enough pixels for this long side (JPEG IDCT scaling).

fields.name: on_error
fields.doc:
"raise" (default) or "null": what a row that cannot be read or decoded
does.

sources.name: image_bytes
sources.doc: Encoded image bytes (PNG/JPEG/TIFF/...), always decoded to `[H, W, C]`.

fields.name: dtype
fields.doc: Asserted element dtype: a decoded image with another dtype is cast.

fields.name: decode_max_size
fields.doc: Decode only enough pixels for this long side (JPEG IDCT scaling).

fields.name: on_error
fields.doc: "raise" (default) or "null": what a row that cannot be decoded does.

sources.name: raw
sources.doc: Raw bytes, decoded as a flat 1-D buffer of `dtype`.

fields.name: dtype
fields.doc: The element dtype: raw bytes carry no type metadata, so it is required.

fields.name: on_error
fields.doc: "raise" (default) or "null": what a row that cannot be decoded does.

fields.name: shape
fields.doc: The output shape; inferred from the planned shape when absent.

sinks.name: blob
sinks.doc:
A format with no parameters: re-encoded by an image codec (``png``,
``webp``, ``tiff``), the self-describing VIEW ``blob``, a nested ``list``,
or the domain's ``native`` Polars type.

fields.name: quality
fields.doc: JPEG quality, 1-100 (default 85). Only the JPEG encoder takes one.

sinks.name: ndarray

fields.name: dtype
fields.doc:
Downcast the elements to this dtype at encode time: only half precision
(``"f16"``/``"float16"``); use ``.cast(...)`` for any other dtype.
